text: Posted to {Place}, officer {Name} missed a first child's birth. Letters home described good meals and new friends, leaving out long shifts checking travel papers and orders barring leave.
self_review: An officer missed the birth of a child while posted away and concealed long duties and barred leave in cheerful letters home.
source_pattern: Plausible invention; the supplied research does not document these letters or this family separation.
fictional_changes: The parenthood, missed birth, letters, posting, and omissions are entirely fictional.
